name: Dandelin.between_of_gram
statement:
theorem between_of_gram {k s m a t d₁ d₂ : ℝ} (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k)
    (hs : 0 < s) (hd₁ : 0 < d₁) (hd : d₁ < d₂) (h₁ : a = d₁ * (m + s)) (h₂ : a = d₂ * (m - s))
    (hQ : 0 ≤ (1 - k ^ 2 - m ^ 2) * t ^ 2 + 2 * k * m * a * t - a ^ 2) :
    d₁ * k ≤ t ∧ t ≤ d₂ * k

name: Dandelin.cone_outside_sphere
statement:
theorem cone_outside_sphere {V u X : E} {k s d : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1)
    (hX : X ∈ cone V u k) : (d * s) ^ 2 ≤ ‖X - (V + d • u)‖ ^ 2

name: Dandelin.cone_tangent_sq
statement:
theorem cone_tangent_sq {V u X : E} {k s d : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1)
    (hX : X ∈ cone V u k) :
    ‖X - (V + d • u)‖ ^ 2 - (d * s) ^ 2 = (‖X - V‖ - d * k) ^ 2

name: Dandelin.dandelin
statement:
theorem dandelin {V u n X F₁ F₂ : E} {k s d₁ d₂ : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s) (hd₁ : 0 < d₁) (hd : d₁ < d₂)
    (hF₁ : F₁ = V + d₁ • u + (d₁ * s) • n) (hF₂ : F₂ = V + d₂ • u - (d₂ * s) • n)
    (hF₂π : ⟪F₂ - F₁, n⟫ = 0) (hXπ : ⟪X - F₁, n⟫ = 0) (hX : X ∈ cone V u k) :
    ‖X - F₁‖ + ‖X - F₂‖ = (d₂ - d₁) * k

name: Dandelin.dandelin_of_between
statement:
theorem dandelin_of_between {V u X F₁ F₂ : E} {k s d₁ d₂ : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hX : X ∈ cone V u k)
    (hF₁ : ‖F₁ - (V + d₁ • u)‖ = d₁ * s) (hF₂ : ‖F₂ - (V + d₂ • u)‖ = d₂ * s)
    (hp₁ : ⟪X - F₁, F₁ - (V + d₁ • u)⟫ = 0) (hp₂ : ⟪X - F₂, F₂ - (V + d₂ • u)⟫ = 0)
    (hb₁ : d₁ * k ≤ ‖X - V‖) (hb₂ : ‖X - V‖ ≤ d₂ * k) :
    ‖X - F₁‖ + ‖X - F₂‖ = (d₂ - d₁) * k

name: Dandelin.dandelin_of_between_isTangentAt
statement:
theorem dandelin_of_between_isTangentAt {V u X F₁ F₂ : E} {k s d₁ d₂ : ℝ}
    {S₁ S₂ : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere E} {π : AffineSubspace ℝ E} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hX : X ∈ cone V u k)
    (hc₁ : S₁.center = V + d₁ • u) (hr₁ : S₁.radius = d₁ * s)
    (hc₂ : S₂.center = V + d₂ • u) (hr₂ : S₂.radius = d₂ * s)
    (ht₁ : S₁.IsTangentAt F₁ π) (ht₂ : S₂.IsTangentAt F₂ π) (hXπ : X ∈ π)
    (hb₁ : d₁ * k ≤ ‖X - V‖) (hb₂ : ‖X - V‖ ≤ d₂ * k) :
    dist X F₁ + dist X F₂ = (d₂ - d₁) * k

Dandelin.dist_tangencyPoint
statement:
theorem dist_tangencyPoint {V X : E} {k d : ℝ} (ht : ‖X - V‖ ≠ 0) :
    ‖X - tangencyPoint V X k d‖ = |‖X - V‖ - d * k|

name: Dandelin.dist_tangent_eq
statement:
theorem dist_tangent_eq {V u X F : E} {k s d : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1)
    (hX : X ∈ cone V u k) (hF : ‖F - (V + d • u)‖ = d * s)
    (hperp : ⟪X - F, F - (V + d • u)⟫ = 0) : ‖X - F‖ = |‖X - V‖ - d * k|

name: Dandelin.focal_dist_eq_div
statement:
theorem focal_dist_eq_div {V u X F : E} {k s d : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1)
    (hk : 0 < k) (hX : X ∈ cone V u k) (hF : ‖F - (V + d • u)‖ = d * s)
    (hperp : ⟪X - F, F - (V + d • u)⟫ = 0) (hb : d * k ≤ ‖X - V‖) :
    ‖X - F‖ = (⟪X - V, u⟫ - d * k ^ 2) / k

name: Dandelin.generator_dist_sq
statement:
theorem generator_dist_sq {V u X : E} {k d τ : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1)
    (hX : X ∈ cone V u k) (ht : ‖X - V‖ ≠ 0) :
    ‖(V + (τ / ‖X - V‖) • (X - V)) - (V + d • u)‖ ^ 2 = τ ^ 2 - 2 * τ * d * k + d ^ 2

name: Dandelin.tangencyPoint_mem_sphere
statement:
theorem tangencyPoint_mem_sphere {V u X : E} {k s d : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hds : 0 ≤ d * s) (hX : X ∈ cone V u k) (ht : ‖X - V‖ ≠ 0) :
    ‖tangencyPoint V X k d - (V + d • u)‖ = d * s

Dandelin.tangent_length_sq
statement:
theorem tangent_length_sq {c F X : E} {r : ℝ} (hF : ‖F - c‖ = r)

name: Dandelin.tangent_lengths_eq

name: Dandelin.converse_alg
statement:
theorem converse_alg {A B t p k d₁ d₂ : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k) (hd₁ : 0 < d₁) (hd : d₁ < d₂)
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hA2 : A ^ 2 = t ^ 2 - 2 * d₁ * p + d₁ ^ 2 * k ^ 2)
    (hB2 : B ^ 2 = t ^ 2 - 2 * d₂ * p + d₂ ^ 2 * k ^ 2) (hsum : A + B = (d₂ - d₁) * k) :
    p = k * t

name: Dandelin.dandelin_converse
statement:
theorem dandelin_converse {V u n X F₁ F₂ : E} {k s d₁ d₂ : ℝ} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hd₁ : 0 < d₁) (hd : d₁ < d₂)
    (hF₁ : F₁ = V + d₁ • u + (d₁ * s) • n) (hF₂ : F₂ = V + d₂ • u - (d₂ * s) • n)
    (hF₂π : ⟪F₂ - F₁, n⟫ = 0) (hXπ : ⟪X - F₁, n⟫ = 0)
    (hsum : ‖X - F₁‖ + ‖X - F₂‖ = (d₂ - d₁) * k) : X ∈ cone V u k

name: Dandelin.dandelin_exists
statement:
theorem dandelin_exists {V u n p₀ : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s) (hm : s < |⟪u, n⟫|)
    (hc : 0 < ⟪u, n⟫ * ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫) :
    ∃ d₁ d₂ : ℝ, ∃ F₁ F₂ : E, 0 < d₁ ∧ d₁ < d₂ ∧
      (∀ d : ℝ, |⟪(V + d • u) - p₀, n⟫| = d * s ↔ d = d₁ ∨ d = d₂) ∧
      ⟪(V + d₁ • u) - p₀, n⟫ * ⟪(V + d₂ • u) - p₀, n⟫ < 0 ∧
      F₁ ∈ plane p₀ n ∧ F₂ ∈ plane p₀ n ∧
      F₁ = (V + d₁ • u) - ⟪(V + d₁ • u) - p₀, n⟫ • n ∧
      F₂ = (V + d₂ • u) - ⟪(V + d₂ • u) - p₀, n⟫ • n ∧
      ∀ X ∈ plane p₀ n, (X ∈ cone V u k ↔ ‖X - F₁‖ + ‖X - F₂‖ = (d₂ - d₁) * k)

name: Dandelin.focus₁_eq_proj
statement:
theorem focus₁_eq_proj (hs : 0 < s) (hm : s < ⟪u, n⟫) :
    focus₁ V u n p₀ s = (V + param₁ V u n p₀ s • u)

theorem focus₁_mem (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) (hs : 0 < s) (hm : s < ⟪u, n⟫) :

theorem focus₂_eq_proj (hs : 0 < s) (hm : s < ⟪u, n⟫) :

name: Dandelin.focus₂_mem
statement:
theorem focus₂_mem (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) (hs : 0 < s) (hm : s < ⟪u, n⟫) :
    focus₂ V u n p₀ s ∈ plane p₀ n

name: Dandelin.inner_center_sub
statement:
theorem inner_center_sub (V u n p₀ : E) (d : ℝ) :
    ⟪(V + d • u) - p₀, n⟫ = d * ⟪u, n⟫ - ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫

name: Dandelin.inner_sub_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
theorem inner_sub_eq_zero_of_mem {p₀ n X Y : E} (hX : X ∈ plane p₀ n) (hY : Y ∈ plane p₀ n) :

name: Dandelin.mem_cone_iff_of_normalised
statement:
theorem mem_cone_iff_of_normalised {V u n p₀ X : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s) (hm : s < ⟪u, n⟫)
    (hc : 0 < ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫) (hX : X ∈ plane p₀ n) :
    X ∈ cone V u k ↔ ‖X - focus₁ V u n p₀ s‖ + ‖X - focus₂ V u n p₀ s‖ =
      (param₂ V u n p₀ s - param₁ V u n p₀ s) * k

name: Dandelin.opposite_sides
statement:
theorem opposite_sides (hs : 0 < s) (hm : s < ⟪u, n⟫) :
    ⟪(V + param₁ V u n p₀ s • u) - p₀, n⟫ = -(param₁ V u n p₀ s * s) ∧
    ⟪(V + param₂ V u n p₀ s • u) - p₀, n⟫ = param₂ V u n p₀ s * s

name: Dandelin.param₁_lt_param₂
statement:

name: Dandelin.param₁_mul
statement:
theorem param₁_mul (hs : 0 < s) (hm : s < ⟪u, n⟫) :
    param₁ V u n p₀ s * (⟪u, n⟫ + s) = ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫

name: Dandelin.param₁_pos
statement:
theorem param₁_pos (hs : 0 < s) (hm : s < ⟪u, n⟫) (hc : 0 < ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫) :

name: Dandelin.param₂_mul
statement:

name: Dandelin.plane_neg
statement: theorem plane_neg (p₀ n : E) : plane p₀ (-n) = plane p₀ n

name: Dandelin.section_bounded
statement:
theorem section_bounded {V u n p₀ : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s) (hm : s < |⟪u, n⟫|)
    (hc : 0 < ⟪u, n⟫ * ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone V u k → ‖X - V‖ ≤ R

name: Dandelin.tangent_iff
statement:
theorem tangent_iff (hs : 0 < s) (hm : s < ⟪u, n⟫) (hc : 0 < ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫) (d : ℝ) :
    |⟪(V + d • u) - p₀, n⟫| = d * s ↔ d = param₁ V u n p₀ s ∨ d = param₂ V u n p₀ s

name: Dandelin.directrix_ellipse
statement:
theorem directrix_ellipse {V u n p₀ : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s) (hm : s < |⟪u, n⟫|)
    (hc : 0 < ⟪u, n⟫ * ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫) (hm1 : ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2 < 1) :
    ecc ⟪u, n⟫ k < 1 ∧ ∃ d₁ d₂ : ℝ, ∃ F₁ F₂ : E, 0 < d₁ ∧ d₁ < d₂ ∧
      (∀ d : ℝ, |⟪(V + d • u) - p₀, n⟫| = d * s ↔ d = d₁ ∨ d = d₂) ∧
      F₁ ∈ plane p₀ n ∧ F₂ ∈ plane p₀ n ∧
      F₁ = (V + d₁ • u) - ⟪(V + d₁ • u) - p₀, n⟫ • n ∧
      F₂ = (V + d₂ • u) - ⟪(V + d₂ • u) - p₀, n⟫ • n ∧
      ∀ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone V u k →
        ‖X - F₁‖ = ecc ⟪u, n⟫ k * Metric.infDist X (directrix V u n p₀ (d₁ * k ^ 2)) ∧
        ‖X - F₂‖ = ecc ⟪u, n⟫ k * Metric.infDist X (directrix V u n p₀ (d₂ * k ^ 2))

name: Dandelin.directrix_parabola
statement:
theorem directrix_parabola {V u n p₀ : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s) (hm : s = |⟪u, n⟫|)
    (hc : 0 < ⟪u, n⟫ * ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫) :
    ecc ⟪u, n⟫ k = 1 ∧ ∃ d : ℝ, ∃ F : E, 0 < d ∧
      (∀ d' : ℝ, |⟪(V + d' • u) - p₀, n⟫| = d' * s ↔ d' = d) ∧
      F ∈ plane p₀ n ∧ F = (V + d • u) - ⟪(V + d • u) - p₀, n⟫ • n ∧
      ∀ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone V u k →
        ‖X - F‖ = Metric.infDist X (directrix V u n p₀ (d * k ^ 2))

name: Dandelin.ecc_eq_one
statement:
theorem ecc_eq_one {m k s : ℝ} (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hm : s = |m|) :

name: Dandelin.ecc_lt_one_iff
statement:
theorem ecc_lt_one_iff {m k s : ℝ} (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s) :

name: Dandelin.exists_orient
statement:
theorem exists_orient {V u n p₀ : E} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) (hc : 0 < ⟪u, n⟫ * ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫) :
    ∃ n' : E, ‖n'‖ = 1 ∧ plane p₀ n' = plane p₀ n ∧ ⟪u, n'⟫ = |⟪u, n⟫| ∧
      0 < ⟪p₀ - V, n'⟫ ∧ (∀ C : E, |⟪C - p₀, n'⟫| = |⟪C - p₀, n⟫|)

name: Dandelin.focal_dist_eq_ecc_mul
statement:
theorem focal_dist_eq_ecc_mul {V u n p₀ X F : E} {k s d : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hm : ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2 < 1) (hXπ : X ∈ plane p₀ n)
    (hX : X ∈ cone V u k) (hF : ‖F - (V + d • u)‖ = d * s)
    (hperp : ⟪X - F, F - (V + d • u)⟫ = 0) :
    ‖X - F‖ = ecc ⟪u, n⟫ k * Metric.infDist X (directrix V u n p₀ (d * k ^ 2))

name: Dandelin.focal_dist_eq_infDist_axisPlane
statement:
theorem focal_dist_eq_infDist_axisPlane {V u X F : E} {k s d : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hX : X ∈ cone V u k)
    (hF : ‖F - (V + d • u)‖ = d * s) (hperp : ⟪X - F, F - (V + d • u)⟫ = 0) :
    ‖X - F‖ = Metric.infDist X (axisPlane V u (d * k ^ 2)) / k

name: Dandelin.infDist_axisPlane
statement:
theorem infDist_axisPlane {V u X : E} {b : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) :
    Metric.infDist X (axisPlane V u b) = |⟪X - V, u⟫ - b|

name: Dandelin.infDist_axisPlane_eq_mul
statement:
theorem infDist_axisPlane_eq_mul {V u n p₀ X : E} {b : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hm : ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2 < 1) (hX : X ∈ plane p₀ n) :
    Metric.infDist X (axisPlane V u b) =
      Real.sqrt (1 - ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2) * Metric.infDist X (directrix V u n p₀ b)

name: Dandelin.infDist_directrix
statement:
theorem infDist_directrix {V u n p₀ X : E} {b : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hm : ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2 < 1) (hX : X ∈ plane p₀ n) :
    Metric.infDist X (directrix V u n p₀ b) =
      |⟪X - V, u⟫ - b| / Real.sqrt (1 - ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2)

name: Dandelin.norm_sub_inner_smul_sq
statement:
theorem norm_sub_inner_smul_sq {u n : E} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) :

name: Dandelin.one_lt_ecc_iff

name: Dandelin.dandelin_hyperbola
statement:
theorem dandelin_hyperbola {V u n p₀ : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s) (hm : |⟪u, n⟫| < s)
    (hc : ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ ≠ 0) :
    1 < ecc ⟪u, n⟫ k ∧
    ∃ d₁ d₂ : ℝ, ∃ F₁ F₂ : E, d₂ < 0 ∧ 0 < d₁ ∧
      (∀ d : ℝ, |⟪(V + d • u) - p₀, n⟫| = |d| * s ↔ d = d₁ ∨ d = d₂) ∧
      F₁ ∈ plane p₀ n ∧ F₂ ∈ plane p₀ n ∧
      F₁ = (V + d₁ • u) - ⟪(V + d₁ • u) - p₀, n⟫ • n ∧
      F₂ = (V + d₂ • u) - ⟪(V + d₂ • u) - p₀, n⟫ • n ∧
      (∀ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone V u k → ‖X - F₂‖ - ‖X - F₁‖ = (d₁ - d₂) * k) ∧
      (∀ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone V (-u) k → ‖X - F₁‖ - ‖X - F₂‖ = (d₁ - d₂) * k) ∧
      (∀ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone2 V u k ↔ |‖X - F₁‖ - ‖X - F₂‖| = (d₁ - d₂) * k) ∧
      (∀ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone2 V u k →
        ‖X - F₁‖ = ecc ⟪u, n⟫ k * Metric.infDist X (directrix V u n p₀ (d₁ * k ^ 2)) ∧
        ‖X - F₂‖ = ecc ⟪u, n⟫ k * Metric.infDist X (directrix V u n p₀ (d₂ * k ^ 2)))

name: Dandelin.dist_tangent_eq_abs
statement:
theorem dist_tangent_eq_abs {V u X F : E} {k s d : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hX : X ∈ cone V u k) (hF : ‖F - (V + d • u)‖ = |d| * s)
    (hperp : ⟪X - F, F - (V + d • u)⟫ = 0) : ‖X - F‖ = |‖X - V‖ - d * k|

name: Dandelin.ecc_neg
statement: theorem ecc_neg (m k : ℝ) : ecc (-m) k = ecc m k

name: Dandelin.focal_dist_eq_ecc_mul_abs
statement:
theorem focal_dist_eq_ecc_mul_abs {V u n p₀ X F : E} {k s d : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1)
    (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hm : ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2 < 1)
    (hXπ : X ∈ plane p₀ n) (hX : X ∈ cone V u k) (hF : ‖F - (V + d • u)‖ = |d| * s)
    (hperp : ⟪X - F, F - (V + d • u)⟫ = 0) :
    ‖X - F‖ = ecc ⟪u, n⟫ k * Metric.infDist X (directrix V u n p₀ (d * k ^ 2))

name: Dandelin.focal_dist_eq_ecc_mul_lower
statement:
theorem focal_dist_eq_ecc_mul_lower {V u n p₀ X F : E} {k s d : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1)
    (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hm : ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2 < 1)
    (hXπ : X ∈ plane p₀ n) (hX : X ∈ cone V (-u) k) (hF : ‖F - (V + d • u)‖ = |d| * s)
    (hperp : ⟪X - F, F - (V + d • u)⟫ = 0) :
    ‖X - F‖ = ecc ⟪u, n⟫ k * Metric.infDist X (directrix V u n p₀ (d * k ^ 2))

name: Dandelin.focal_sq
statement:
theorem focal_sq {V u X F : E} {k s d : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1)
    (hF : ‖F - (V + d • u)‖ = |d| * s) (hp : ⟪X - F, F - (V + d • u)⟫ = 0) :
    ‖X - F‖ ^ 2 = ‖X - V‖ ^ 2 - 2 * d * ⟪X - V, u⟫ + d ^ 2 * k ^ 2

name: Dandelin.hyp_between
statement:
theorem hyp_between {k s m a t d₁ : ℝ} (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k)
    (hs : 0 < s) (hm1 : -s < m) (hm2 : m < s) (hd₁ : 0 < d₁) (h₁ : a = d₁ * (m + s))
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hQ : 0 ≤ (1 - k ^ 2 - m ^ 2) * t ^ 2 + 2 * k * m * a * t - a ^ 2) :
    d₁ * k ≤ t

name: Dandelin.hyp_converse
statement:
theorem hyp_converse {V u X F₁ F₂ : E} {k s d₁ d₂ : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hd : d₁ ≠ d₂)
    (hF₁ : ‖F₁ - (V + d₁ • u)‖ = |d₁| * s) (hp₁ : ⟪X - F₁, F₁ - (V + d₁ • u)⟫ = 0)
    (hF₂ : ‖F₂ - (V + d₂ • u)‖ = |d₂| * s) (hp₂ : ⟪X - F₂, F₂ - (V + d₂ • u)⟫ = 0)
    (hdiff : |‖X - F₁‖ - ‖X - F₂‖| = (d₁ - d₂) * k) : X ∈ cone2 V u k

name: Dandelin.hyp_converse_alg
statement:
theorem hyp_converse_alg {A B t p k d₁ d₂ e : ℝ} (hd : d₁ ≠ d₂) (he : e ^ 2 = 1)
    (hA2 : A ^ 2 = t ^ 2 - 2 * d₁ * p + d₁ ^ 2 * k ^ 2)
    (hB2 : B ^ 2 = t ^ 2 - 2 * d₂ * p + d₂ ^ 2 * k ^ 2)
    (hdiff : A - B = e * ((d₁ - d₂) * k)) : p ^ 2 = k ^ 2 * t ^ 2

name: Dandelin.hyp_lower
statement:
theorem hyp_lower {V u n p₀ X F₁ F₂ : E} {k s d₁ d₂ : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s) (hm1 : -s < ⟪u, n⟫)
    (hm2 : ⟪u, n⟫ < s) (hd₁ : 0 < d₁) (hd₂ : d₂ < 0) (hc₂ : ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ = d₂ * (⟪u, n⟫ - s))
    (hF₁ : ‖F₁ - (V + d₁ • u)‖ = |d₁| * s) (hp₁ : ⟪X - F₁, F₁ - (V + d₁ • u)⟫ = 0)
    (hF₂ : ‖F₂ - (V + d₂ • u)‖ = |d₂| * s) (hp₂ : ⟪X - F₂, F₂ - (V + d₂ • u)⟫ = 0)
    (hXπ : X ∈ plane p₀ n) (hX : X ∈ cone V (-u) k) :
    ‖X - F₁‖ - ‖X - F₂‖ = (d₁ - d₂) * k

name: Dandelin.hyp_orient
statement:
theorem hyp_orient {V u n p₀ : E} {s : ℝ} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) (hm : |⟪u, n⟫| < s)
    (hc : ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ n' : E, ‖n'‖ = 1 ∧ plane p₀ n' = plane p₀ n ∧ -s < ⟪u, n'⟫ ∧ ⟪u, n'⟫ < s ∧
      0 < ⟪p₀ - V, n'⟫ ∧ (∀ C : E, |⟪C - p₀, n'⟫| = |⟪C - p₀, n⟫|)

name: Dandelin.hyp_param_sub
statement:
theorem hyp_param_sub {V u n p₀ : E} {s : ℝ} (hm1 : -s < ⟪u, n⟫) (hm2 : ⟪u, n⟫ < s) :
    param₁ V u n p₀ s - param₂ V u n p₀ s =
      2 * s * ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ / (s ^ 2 - ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2)

name: Dandelin.hyp_param₁_pos
statement:
theorem hyp_param₁_pos {V u n p₀ : E} {s : ℝ} (hm1 : -s < ⟪u, n⟫) (hc : 0 < ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫) :
    0 < param₁ V u n p₀ s

name: Dandelin.hyp_param₂_neg
statement:
theorem hyp_param₂_neg {V u n p₀ : E} {s : ℝ} (hm2 : ⟪u, n⟫ < s) (hc : 0 < ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫) :
    param₂ V u n p₀ s < 0

name: Dandelin.hyp_tangent_iff
statement:
theorem hyp_tangent_iff {V u n p₀ : E} {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hm1 : -s < ⟪u, n⟫)
    (hm2 : ⟪u, n⟫ < s) (d : ℝ) :
    |⟪(V + d • u) - p₀, n⟫| = |d| * s ↔ d = param₁ V u n p₀ s ∨ d = param₂ V u n p₀ s

name: Dandelin.hyp_upper
statement:
theorem hyp_upper {V u n p₀ X F₁ F₂ : E} {k s d₁ d₂ : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s) (hm1 : -s < ⟪u, n⟫)
    (hm2 : ⟪u, n⟫ < s) (hd₁ : 0 < d₁) (hd₂ : d₂ < 0) (hc : ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ = d₁ * (⟪u, n⟫ + s))
    (hF₁ : ‖F₁ - (V + d₁ • u)‖ = |d₁| * s) (hp₁ : ⟪X - F₁, F₁ - (V + d₁ • u)⟫ = 0)
    (hF₂ : ‖F₂ - (V + d₂ • u)‖ = |d₂| * s) (hp₂ : ⟪X - F₂, F₂ - (V + d₂ • u)⟫ = 0)
    (hXπ : X ∈ plane p₀ n) (hX : X ∈ cone V u k) :
    ‖X - F₂‖ - ‖X - F₁‖ = (d₁ - d₂) * k

name: Dandelin.mem_cone2_iff
statement:
theorem mem_cone2_iff {V u X : E} {k : ℝ} :
    X ∈ cone2 V u k ↔ X ∈ cone V u k ∨ X ∈ cone V (-u) k

name: Dandelin.exists_generator_of_mem_cone
statement:
theorem exists_generator_of_mem_cone {V u X : E} {k : ℝ} (hX : X ∈ cone V u k) (hXV : X ≠ V) :
    ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ ∃ w : E, ‖w‖ = 1 ∧ ⟪w, u⟫ = k ∧ X = V + t • w

name: Dandelin.generator_mem_cone
statement:
theorem generator_mem_cone {V u w : E} {k t : ℝ} (hw : ‖w‖ = 1) (hwu : ⟪w, u⟫ = k)
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) : V + t • w ∈ cone V u k

name: Dandelin.isTangentAt_focus₁
statement:
theorem isTangentAt_focus₁ {V u n p₀ : E} {s : ℝ} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hm : s < ⟪u, n⟫) (hc : 0 < ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫) :
    (⟨V + param₁ V u n p₀ s • u, param₁ V u n p₀ s * s⟩ : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere E).IsTangentAt
      (focus₁ V u n p₀ s) (AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ)

name: Dandelin.isTangentAt_focus₂
statement:
theorem isTangentAt_focus₂ {V u n p₀ : E} {s : ℝ} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hm : s < ⟪u, n⟫) (hc : 0 < ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫) :
    (⟨V + param₂ V u n p₀ s • u, param₂ V u n p₀ s * s⟩ : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere E).IsTangentAt
      (focus₂ V u n p₀ s) (AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ)

name: Dandelin.isTangentAt_tangencyPoint
statement:
theorem isTangentAt_tangencyPoint {V u X : E} {k s d : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hds : 0 ≤ d * s) (hX : X ∈ cone V u k) (ht : ‖X - V‖ ≠ 0) :
    (⟨V + d • u, d * s⟩ : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere E).IsTangentAt (tangencyPoint V X k d)
      line[ℝ, V, X]

name: Dandelin.mem_cone2_iff_angle
statement:
theorem mem_cone2_iff_angle {V u X : E} {α : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hα : α ∈ Set.Icc 0 Real.pi)
    (hX : X ≠ V) :
    X ∈ cone2 V u (Real.cos α) ↔ angle (X - V) u = α ∨ angle (X - V) u = Real.pi - α

name: Dandelin.mem_cone_iff_angle
statement:
theorem mem_cone_iff_angle {V u X : E} {α : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hα : α ∈ Set.Icc 0 Real.pi)
    (hX : X ≠ V) : X ∈ cone V u (Real.cos α) ↔ angle (X - V) u = α

name: Dandelin.mem_plane_iff
statement: theorem mem_plane_iff {p₀ n X : E} : X ∈ plane p₀ n ↔ ⟪X - p₀, n⟫ = 0

name: Dandelin.plane_eq_mk'
statement:
theorem plane_eq_mk' (p₀ n : E) :
    plane p₀ n = (AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ : Set E)

name: Dandelin.tangencyPoint_mem_line
statement:
theorem tangencyPoint_mem_line (V X : E) (k d : ℝ) :
    tangencyPoint V X k d ∈ line[ℝ, V, X]

name: Dandelin.abs_lt_of_both_nappes
statement:
theorem abs_lt_of_both_nappes {V u n p₀ X Y : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s) (hc : ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ ≠ 0)
    (hX : X ∈ plane p₀ n) (hXc : X ∈ cone V u k) (hY : Y ∈ plane p₀ n)
    (hYc : Y ∈ cone V (-u) k) : |⟪u, n⟫| < s

name: Dandelin.bounded_iff
statement:
theorem bounded_iff [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (hdim : 3 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E)
    {V u n p₀ : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s) (hc : ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ ≠ 0) :
    s < |⟪u, n⟫| ↔ Bornology.IsBounded (plane p₀ n ∩ cone2 V u k)

name: Dandelin.ellipse_nonempty
statement:
theorem ellipse_nonempty [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (hdim : 2 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E)
    {V u n p₀ : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s) (hm : s < |⟪u, n⟫|)
    (hc : 0 < ⟪u, n⟫ * ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫) : ∃ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone V u k

name: Dandelin.ellipse_regime
statement:
theorem ellipse_regime {V u n p₀ : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s) (hm : s < |⟪u, n⟫|)
    (hc : ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ ≠ 0) :
    ((∀ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone2 V u k → X ∈ cone V u k) ∨
      (∀ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone2 V u k → X ∈ cone V (-u) k)) ∧
    ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone2 V u k → ‖X - V‖ ≤ R

name: Dandelin.ellipse_regime_iff
statement:
theorem ellipse_regime_iff [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (hdim : 3 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E)
    {V u n p₀ : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s) (hc : ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ ≠ 0) :
    s < |⟪u, n⟫| ↔
      ((∀ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone2 V u k → X ∈ cone V u k) ∨
        (∀ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone2 V u k → X ∈ cone V (-u) k)) ∧
      Bornology.IsBounded (plane p₀ n ∩ cone2 V u k)

name: Dandelin.exists_small_eps
statement:
theorem exists_small_eps {x ρ c R : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hx : |x| ≤ ρ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, ε ≠ 0 ∧ |ε - x| ≤ ρ ∧ R < |c / ε|

name: Dandelin.exists_unit_orth
statement:
theorem exists_unit_orth [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (S : Finset E)
    (h : S.card < Module.finrank ℝ E) : ∃ f : E, ‖f‖ = 1 ∧ ∀ x ∈ S, ⟪f, x⟫ = 0

statement: theorem finrank_R3 : 3 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))

statement:
theorem gen_dir {u e : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (heu : ⟪e, u⟫ = 0)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) : ‖k • u + s • e‖ = 1 ∧ ⟪k • u + s • e, u⟫ = k

name: Dandelin.gen_mem_cone
statement:
theorem gen_mem_cone {V u w : E} {k t : ℝ} (hw : ‖w‖ = 1) (hwu : ⟪w, u⟫ = k) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    V + t • w ∈ cone V u k

name: Dandelin.gen_mem_cone_neg
statement:
theorem gen_mem_cone_neg {V u w : E} {k t : ℝ} (hw : ‖w‖ = 1) (hwu : ⟪w, u⟫ = k)
    (ht : t ≤ 0) : V + t • w ∈ cone V (-u) k

name: Dandelin.gen_mem_plane
statement:
theorem gen_mem_plane {V w p₀ n : E} (hwn : ⟪w, n⟫ ≠ 0) :
    V + (⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ / ⟪w, n⟫) • w ∈ plane p₀ n

name: Dandelin.gen_norm
statement: theorem gen_norm {V w : E} {t : ℝ} (hw : ‖w‖ = 1) : ‖V + t • w - V‖ = |t|

name: Dandelin.gen_point
statement:
theorem gen_point {V u n p₀ e : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (heu : ⟪e, u⟫ = 0)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hδ : ⟪k • u + s • e, n⟫ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ X ∈ plane p₀ n, ‖X - V‖ = |⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ / ⟪k • u + s • e, n⟫| ∧
      (0 ≤ ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ / ⟪k • u + s • e, n⟫ → X ∈ cone V u k) ∧
      (⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ / ⟪k • u + s • e, n⟫ ≤ 0 → X ∈ cone V (-u) k)

name: Dandelin.gen_point_a
statement:
theorem gen_point_a {V u n p₀ f : E} {k s a b : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hr : ‖perpN u n‖ ≠ 0) (hfu : ⟪f, u⟫ = 0) (hfn : ⟪f, n⟫ = 0)
    (hab : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 * ‖f‖ ^ 2 = 1) (hδ : k * ⟪u, n⟫ + s * (a * ‖perpN u n‖) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ X ∈ plane p₀ n,
      ‖X - V‖ = |⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ / (k * ⟪u, n⟫ + s * (a * ‖perpN u n‖))| ∧
      (0 ≤ ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ / (k * ⟪u, n⟫ + s * (a * ‖perpN u n‖)) → X ∈ cone V u k) ∧
      (⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ / (k * ⟪u, n⟫ + s * (a * ‖perpN u n‖)) ≤ 0 → X ∈ cone V (-u) k)

name: Dandelin.hyp_both_nappes
statement:
theorem hyp_both_nappes {V u n p₀ : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (_hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s) (hm : |⟪u, n⟫| < s)
    (hc : ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ ≠ 0) :
    (∃ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone V u k) ∧ (∃ Y ∈ plane p₀ n, Y ∈ cone V (-u) k)

name: Dandelin.hyperbola_regime_iff
statement:
theorem hyperbola_regime_iff {V u n p₀ : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s) (hc : ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ ≠ 0) :
    |⟪u, n⟫| < s ↔
      (∃ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone V u k) ∧ (∃ Y ∈ plane p₀ n, Y ∈ cone V (-u) k)

name: Dandelin.inner_sub_V_of_mem_plane
statement:
theorem inner_sub_V_of_mem_plane {V p₀ n X : E} (hX : X ∈ plane p₀ n) :

name: Dandelin.mem_cone2_of_le_total
statement:
theorem mem_cone2_of_le_total {V u X : E} {k t : ℝ} (h1 : 0 ≤ t → X ∈ cone V u k)
    (h2 : t ≤ 0 → X ∈ cone V (-u) k) : X ∈ cone2 V u k

name: Dandelin.nappe_sign
statement:
theorem nappe_sign {V u n p₀ X : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hm : s ^ 2 ≤ ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2)
    (hc : ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ ≠ 0) (hX : X ∈ plane p₀ n) (hXc : X ∈ cone V u k) :
    0 < ⟪u, n⟫ * ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫

name: Dandelin.nappe_sign_neg
statement:
theorem nappe_sign_neg {V u n p₀ X : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hm : s ^ 2 ≤ ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2)
    (hc : ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ ≠ 0) (hX : X ∈ plane p₀ n) (hXc : X ∈ cone V (-u) k) :
    ⟪u, n⟫ * ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ < 0

name: Dandelin.one_nappe
statement:
theorem one_nappe {V u n p₀ : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s) (hm : s ≤ |⟪u, n⟫|)
    (hc : ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ ≠ 0) :
    (0 < ⟪u, n⟫ * ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ ∧ ∀ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone2 V u k → X ∈ cone V u k) ∨
      (⟪u, n⟫ * ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ < 0 ∧ ∀ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone2 V u k → X ∈ cone V (-u) k)

name: Dandelin.parabola_regime
statement:
theorem parabola_regime [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (hdim : 3 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E)
    {V u n p₀ : E} {k s : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hks : k ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hs : 0 < s) (hm : |⟪u, n⟫| = s)
    (hc : ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫ ≠ 0) :
    ((∀ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone2 V u k → X ∈ cone V u k) ∨
      (∀ X ∈ plane p₀ n, X ∈ cone2 V u k → X ∈ cone V (-u) k)) ∧

name: Dandelin.l14_apex_R3
statement:
theorem l14_apex_R3 {V u n : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)} {α : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1)
    (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < Real.pi / 2) :
    (Real.sin α < |⟪u, n⟫| → (AffineSubspace.mk' V (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ : Set _) ∩
      {X | X = V ∨ angle (X - V) u = α ∨ angle (X - V) u = Real.pi - α} = {V}) ∧
    (|⟪u, n⟫| = Real.sin α → u - ⟪u, n⟫ • n ≠ 0 ∧ (AffineSubspace.mk' V (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ : Set _) ∩
      {X | X = V ∨ angle (X - V) u = α ∨ angle (X - V) u = Real.pi - α} =
        (line[ℝ, V, V + (u - ⟪u, n⟫ • n)] : Set _)) ∧
    (|⟪u, n⟫| < Real.sin α → ∃ f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3), ∃ ρ : ℝ,
      ‖f‖ = 1 ∧ ⟪f, u⟫ = 0 ∧ ⟪f, n⟫ = 0 ∧ 0 < ρ ∧
      (AffineSubspace.mk' V (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ : Set _) ∩
        {X | X = V ∨ angle (X - V) u = α ∨ angle (X - V) u = Real.pi - α} =
        (line[ℝ, V, V + ((u - ⟪u, n⟫ • n) + ρ • f)] : Set _) ∪
          (line[ℝ, V, V + ((u - ⟪u, n⟫ • n) - ρ • f)] : Set _) ∧
      (line[ℝ, V, V + ((u - ⟪u, n⟫ • n) + ρ • f)] : Set _) ∩
          (line[ℝ, V, V + ((u - ⟪u, n⟫ • n) - ρ • f)] : Set _) = {V})

name: Dandelin.l14_dandelin_ellipse
statement:
theorem l14_dandelin_ellipse {V u n p₀ : E} {α : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < Real.pi / 2) (hm : Real.sin α < |⟪u, n⟫|)
    (hc : 0 < ⟪u, n⟫ * ⟪p₀ - V, n⟫) :
    ∃ d₁ d₂ : ℝ, ∃ F₁ F₂ : E, ∃ L : ℝ, 0 < d₁ ∧ d₁ < d₂ ∧ 0 < L ∧
      (∀ d : ℝ, (⟨V + d • u, d * Real.sin α⟩ : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere E).IsTangent
          (AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ) ↔ d = d₁ ∨ d = d₂) ∧
      (⟨V + d₁ • u, d₁ * Real.sin α⟩ : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere E).IsTangentAt F₁
        (AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ) ∧
      (⟨V + d₂ • u, d₂ * Real.sin α⟩ : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere E).IsTangentAt F₂
        (AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ) ∧
      ⟪(V + d₁ • u) - p₀, n⟫ * ⟪(V + d₂ • u) - p₀, n⟫ < 0 ∧
      ∀ X ∈ AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ,
        ((X = V ∨ angle (X - V) u = α) ↔ dist X F₁ + dist X F₂ = L)

name: Dandelin.l14_dandelin_hyperbola
statement:
theorem l14_dandelin_hyperbola {V u n p₀ : E} {α : ℝ} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < Real.pi / 2) (hm : |⟪u, n⟫| < Real.sin α)
    (hc : V ∉ AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ) :
    1 < Real.sqrt (1 - ⟪u, n⟫ ^ 2) / Real.cos α ∧
    ∃ d₁ d₂ : ℝ, ∃ F₁ F₂ : E, ∃ L : ℝ, d₂ < 0 ∧ 0 < d₁ ∧ 0 < L ∧
      (∀ d : ℝ, (⟨V + d • u, |d| * Real.sin α⟩ : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere E).IsTangent
          (AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ) ↔ d = d₁ ∨ d = d₂) ∧
      (⟨V + d₁ • u, |d₁| * Real.sin α⟩ : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere E).IsTangentAt F₁
        (AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ) ∧
      (⟨V + d₂ • u, |d₂| * Real.sin α⟩ : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere E).IsTangentAt F₂
        (AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ) ∧
      (∀ X ∈ AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ, (X = V ∨ angle (X - V) u = α) →
        dist X F₂ - dist X F₁ = L) ∧
      (∀ X ∈ AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ, (X = V ∨ angle (X - V) u = Real.pi - α) →
        dist X F₁ - dist X F₂ = L) ∧
      (∀ X ∈ AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ,
        (X = V ∨ angle (X - V) u = α ∨ angle (X - V) u = Real.pi - α) ↔
          |dist X F₁ - dist X F₂| = L) ∧

            ((AffineSubspace.mk' p₀ (ℝ ∙ n)ᗮ ⊓
              AffineSubspace.mk' (V + (d₁ * Real.cos α ^ 2) • u) (ℝ ∙ u)ᗮ :
                AffineSubspace ℝ E) : Set E)) ∧
        ((X = V ∨ angle (X - V) u = α ∨ angle (X - V) u = Real.pi - α) ↔

lemma l15_ell_pkg {V u : E3} (hu : u ≠ 0) {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < π / 2)
    {P : AffineSubspace ℝ E3} {p₀ n : E3} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hPn : ∀ X : E3, X ∈ P ↔ inner ℝ (X - p₀) n = 0) {e : E3} (he_def : e = ‖u‖⁻¹ • u)
    {σ : ℝ} {e' : E3} (hσ : σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) (he' : e' = σ • e) (he'n : ‖e'‖ = 1)
    (hm : Real.sin α < |inner ℝ e' n|) (hc : 0 < inner ℝ e' n * inner ℝ (p₀ - V) n) :
    ∃ d₁ d₂ : ℝ, ∃ F₁ F₂ : E3, 0 < d₁ ∧ d₁ < d₂ ∧
      (∀ S, IsDandelinSphere V u α P S ↔
        S = l15_S V e' (Real.sin α) d₁ ∨ S = l15_S V e' (Real.sin α) d₂) ∧
      inner ℝ ((V + d₁ • e') - p₀) n * inner ℝ ((V + d₂ • e') - p₀) n < 0 ∧
      F₁ ∈ P ∧ F₂ ∈ P ∧
      F₁ = (V + d₁ • e') - inner ℝ ((V + d₁ • e') - p₀) n • n ∧
      F₂ = (V + d₂ • e') - inner ℝ ((V + d₂ • e') - p₀) n • n ∧
      (∀ X ∈ P, X ∈ cone V u α ↔ dist X F₁ + dist X F₂ = (d₂ - d₁) * Real.cos α) ∧
      (∃ X ∈ P, X ∈ cone V u α)

statement:
lemma l15_hyp_pkg {V u : E3} (hu : u ≠ 0) {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < π / 2)
    {P : AffineSubspace ℝ E3} {p₀ n : E3} (hn : ‖n‖ = 1)
    (hPn : ∀ X : E3, X ∈ P ↔ inner ℝ (X - p₀) n = 0) {e : E3} (he_def : e = ‖u‖⁻¹ • u)
    (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (hm : |inner ℝ e n| < Real.sin α) (hc : inner ℝ (p₀ - V) n ≠ 0) :
    ∃ d₁ d₂ : ℝ, ∃ F₁ F₂ : E3, d₂ < 0 ∧ 0 < d₁ ∧
      (∀ S, IsDandelinSphere V u α P S ↔
        S = l15_S V e (Real.sin α) d₁ ∨ S = l15_S V e (Real.sin α) d₂) ∧
      F₁ ∈ P ∧ F₂ ∈ P ∧
      F₁ = (V + d₁ • e) - inner ℝ ((V + d₁ • e) - p₀) n • n ∧
      F₂ = (V + d₂ • e) - inner ℝ ((V + d₂ • e) - p₀) n • n ∧
      (∀ X ∈ P, X ∈ Dandelin.cone V e (Real.cos α) →
        dist X F₂ - dist X F₁ = (d₁ - d₂) * Real.cos α) ∧
      (∀ X ∈ P, X ∈ Dandelin.cone V (-e) (Real.cos α) →
        dist X F₁ - dist X F₂ = (d₁ - d₂) * Real.cos α) ∧
      (∀ X ∈ P, X ∈ cone V u α ↔ |dist X F₁ - dist X F₂| = (d₁ - d₂) * Real.cos α) ∧
      (∃ X ∈ P, X ∈ Dandelin.cone V e (Real.cos α)) ∧
      (∃ Y ∈ P, Y ∈ Dandelin.cone V (-e) (Real.cos α))

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_setup
statement:
lemma l15_setup {V u : E3} (hu : u ≠ 0) (P : AffineSubspace ℝ E3)
    (hP : Module.finrank ℝ P.direction = 2) (hVP : V ∉ P) :
    ∃ p₀ n e : E3, ‖n‖ = 1 ∧ p₀ ∈ P ∧ (∀ X : E3, X ∈ P ↔ inner ℝ (X - p₀) n = 0) ∧
      e = ‖u‖⁻¹ • u ∧ ‖e‖ = 1 ∧ inner ℝ (p₀ - V) n ≠ 0 ∧
      Real.cos (planeAxisAngle u P) = √(1 - inner ℝ e n ^ 2) ∧
      0 ≤ planeAxisAngle u P ∧ planeAxisAngle u P ≤ π / 2 ∧ inner ℝ e n ^ 2 ≤ 1

name: Dandelin.Classical.l15_tangent_cone_iff
statement:
lemma l15_tangent_cone_iff {V u : E3} (hu : u ≠ 0) {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < π / 2)
    (S : Sphere E3) (C : Set E3) :
    TangentToConeAlong V u α S C ↔
      (∃ d : ℝ, d ≠ 0 ∧ S.center = V + d • (‖u‖⁻¹ • u) ∧ S.radius = |d| * Real.sin α) ∧
        C = Metric.sphere S.center S.radius ∩ cone V u α
